column1: # BatchRenderer batch: owner <TAB> kind <TAB> old <TAB> descriptor <TAB> semantic name
# Evidence, field by field - every name comes from the constructor that initialises it:
#   j/k/l = shader attribute locations a_position / a_texCoord / a_color
#   m/n/o = shader uniform locations   s_texture / u_mvpMatrix / u_texScale
#   e/f/g = float vertex array, its write cursor, its capacity (i2 = f/16 vertices, f*4 bytes)
#   a/b/c = short array, its write cursor, its capacity (SpriteBatch flushes when b >= c)
#   d     = true on Desktop/WebGL, selecting the float VBO vertex format over the packed short one
#   q     = GL_ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER (34963) holding the 6-index quad pattern
#   r/s   = GL_ARRAY_BUFFER (34962) for the short data / for the float vertex data
#   p     = round robin index over the buffer ring (p = (p+1) % r.length)
#   h     = widget tree root, set by a(Widget) and read by b()
#   i/t/u = shader program, the atlas texture, the SpriteBatch that feeds this renderer
# Method names come from their bodies: a() reads t, b() reads h, a(Widget) writes h,
# a(ActionListener,float,float,boolean) forwards to Widget.handleInput, a(int,int) rebuilds the
# MVP matrix from the viewport size, c() draws the widget tree, d() flushes the pending batch,
# e() disposes every GL object. a-g are package-private and are written directly by SpriteBatch,
# which is why this batch must stay symbol-wide instead of a per-file edit.
